craft_notes: Sthāyin: name unfolded. Rows: garlands then oneness. Read aloud: garland string.

lines: And meet is this her name: garlanded with Rudra's strings of might,
in fruits abloom, the hum that ends the winter of the world,
since ra and la are one, 'tis said.
l4.sanskrit_cite: anvarthaṃ caitan nāma rudraśaktimālābhir yuktā phaleṣu puṣpitā saṃsāraśiśirasaṃhāranādabhramarī siddhimokṣadhāriṇī dānādānaśaktiyuktā iti ralayor ekatvasmṛteḥ
